Katsuragi Ace claimed victory in the 
Takarazuka Kinen. It was a run truly 
worthy of claiming the title of the 
strongest in medium distance. However—

The public's attention lay elsewhere. Mr. 
C.B.'s entry into the Tenno Sho (Autumn). 
And the high expectations for Symboli 
Rudolf to achieve an undefeated Triple 
Crown.

Nowhere was her name to be seen. It was as 
if an insurmountable wall separated her 
from that "different world." Katsuragi Ace 
couldn't hide her indignation.

"That is why she must win and prove it. 
That Katsuragi Ace and her rivals are by 
no means from 'another world.'"

First, set sights on Mr. C.B.'s comeback 
race, the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
